answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 168021 Country: India Title: Which dua to recite if I suddenly see or meet some kind of thing like jinn, ghost etc? Question: If I suddenly see or meet some kind of thing like jinn, ghost and witch, what dua or surah I should recite and how can I get safe in front of that shay. Answer ID: 168021 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 463/396/N=06/1440) In case a jinn, ghost and witch is seen, one should recite Ayatul Kursi and mu’awazatain loudly. In-shaAllah, the jinn or ghost shall go away and will not cause any harm. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
